data.gender_notes: Latimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'latama', meaning 'to be submissive or surrender to Allah'. This name is often given to girls in the Muslim world as a reminder of their commitment to their faith. The name Latimah carries the meaning “Submissive to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Latimah usually hope their child will grow to embody submissive to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Latimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Submissive to Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Latimah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
